result.Method of Attack: Backdoor embedded in a malicious shared object (SO) file loaded by sshd binary; hijacks OpenSSL function RSA_public_decrypt to allow remote arbitrary code execution with knowledge of a specific private SSH key; preserves normal SSH functionality to avoid detection
Impacted Systems: Fedora Linux 40 beta and Fedora Rawhide
result.Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via malicious version of xz-utils package; installation of malicious shared object file loaded dynamically by sshd
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of malicious SO file loaded by sshd
Specific function signature in liblzma detected by hexdump pattern f30f1efa554889f54c89ce5389fb81e7000000804883ec28488954241848894c2410
